description: NarraTV: AI-Driven Scene Audio Description for Fire TV and Blind/Low-Vision Viewers

scripts._comment_esbuild: CDK's NodejsFunction bundles by shelling out to `yarn run esbuild` from the workspace ROOT. Yarn 4 does not expose a workspace dependency's binary as a root script, so without this line bundling dies with 'Couldn't find a script named esbuild' and every Lambda fails to synthesize. Do not remove it because nothing appears to call it - CDK does.
